notes: This is a contest, not a job. The page is for the 2026 contest. Expect similar timing next year, from August to late September.
name: Young Artist Competition (Ann Arbor Symphony Orchestra)
what_you_do: Send in a video of a solo with orchestra. The winner plays with the full professional orchestra at the Link Up youth concert and gets a cash prize.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12 who go to school in Michigan and play a string, wind, brass or percussion instrument (harp too). Pianists are not considered.
pay_detail: $50 application fee (email jpepper@a2so.org if the fee is a problem). Prizes: $500 grand prize, $250 runner-up.
duration: Final round Nov 7, 2026. Winner plays Feb 23, 2027.
deadline_text: 2026 application closed Sept 25, 2026 at 10 AM. Final round is Nov 7, 2026. Next year dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Google Form on the A2SO site. Send a one take YouTube video of you playing one part of a solo piece with an accompanist.
